articles.title: Life sentence for terrorist who attempted attack on Israeli Embassy in Britain
articles.description: A British court sentenced a man of Kuwaiti origin to life in prison after he attempted to break into the Israeli Embassy in London last year and carry out a stabbing attack.
articles.content:
